question: Can a two-member player party against one opponent produce completed healthy-stay and critical-switch choices under a common four-turn horizon?
terminal_gate: All matched branches end in battle_won or party_defeated within four player turns. Stop immediately on the first nonterminal scenario.
reversal_gate: Both healthy scenarios favor attack over switch by more than 0.10 mean return; both critical scenarios favor switch over attack by more than 0.10. Stop after the first failed pair.
reserved_semantic_variations_before_fit: Same two matchups with opponent level raised from 35 to 37 and otherwise identical cases
Same two matchups with healthy lead HP reduced by 5 and critical lead HP raised from 8 to 10
promotion_gate: Separate unseen semantic variations and genuinely independent natural trainer origins after a frozen model fit; this pilot alone cannot promote authority.
assistance: Teacher-only initial species, moves, HP and opponent setup on isolated TRAIN copies; actor has no save-edit action.
stop_condition: No replay or same-recipe refit after a failed terminal or reversal gate; preserve all executed branches.
